scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:worker:win32: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app worker -l info --pool=solo
scripts.dev:worker:darwin: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app worker -l info
scripts.dev:worker:linux: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app worker -l info
scripts.dev:worker:default: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app worker -l info
